tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Prices for a preview, a pack and a re-render, in USDC on Base. Free.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: The manifest of a real Production Pack built by the same engine. Free.

tools.name: create_preview
tools.description: Start a paid preview ($1): three logo directions with QA. Returns a preview_id and a status_url to poll. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Status of a preview and, when ready, the directions with their QA. Free.

tools.name: create_pack
tools.description: Buy the Production Pack for a chosen direction ($19, less the preview credit). Returns an order_id and a status_url. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Status of a pack order and, when delivered, the manifest and download URL. Free.
